items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I'm thinking of Lester Young, and Basie had a great tenor player named Herschel Evans that played the sweet stuff

ctx.x: You know, we were talking about John Hammond. I think it was John Hammond that brought Basie to New York.

Yeah. That guy has helped a lot of guys. He brought Basie to New York, and he hasn't looked gone back since. I'm thinking of Lester Young, and Basie had a great tenor player named Herschel Evans that played the sweet stuff, and they left Pres with his crooked neck saxophone. In fact, I think John Hammond was instrumental in getting Basie into the great Apollo Theater in New York at 125th and 7th Avenue, because I remember the first time that I saw Basie's band actually, really playing, you know. They were --…
And the Apollo Theater, you know, and they would get behind the curtain and when the band would start playing, the curtain would stay down for, you know, a minute or so, and it went --
